title: 24-byte resource record initialization
summary: Recovered Game.exe VA 0x5436c0 (RVA 0x1436c0): thiscall writes six words to 0,0,0,0xffffffff,0,0 and returns this. A constructor-equivalent member preserves the explicit return value. Three direct calls at 0x54451d, 0x544534 and 0x544540 initialize stack records; there are no dependencies, branches, imports or FS accesses in the target.
test_description: Compare original thiscall reference at its original VA with recovered member for seven initial word patterns including zero, all ones, high bit and alternating bits; repeat initialization to check idempotence. Assert returned pointer, all six field values, 16-byte guards on each side, and FS head restoration after every original invocation. Require successful test_install_fs.
known_limits: Field meanings and full containing resource types remain unresolved; fields are represented as six fixed-width words.
Valid writable 24-byte objects are required. Null and invalid pointers fault in the original and are outside the callable C++ contract.
Adjacent destructor and larger caller are evidence only, not recovered scope.
No byte matching or complete-game recovery claim.
